current.text: He signed with Minnesota and is projected as the fifth starter next to Ball, Edwards, McDaniels and Gobert. Reports say he was promised a starting spot.

Experts doubt he will play real starter minutes. One expects him to start but play only about 21 minutes while another player closes games. Others say his starting spot is not guaranteed and may not last all season.
His usage should drop next to Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball and Jaden McDaniels, but stay above 20%.
He is a late flyer only. Do not take him inside the top 100. He is fair value around pick 115 to 148. Drop him quickly if his role does not grow.
Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The two-game week, starting March 15, is the semifinal.
Minnesota has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.

durable.text: He is a scoring-first player who is worth more in points leagues than in 9-cat.
He gives little in steals, blocks and assists.
He is a poor free throw shooter and a weak three-point shooter.
His big fantasy games have come when teammates were out, such as Jalen Johnson in Atlanta. He is buried again once they return.
Experts see him as a poor defender with a negative defensive impact who is lazy on defense.

note: He costs about 1 USD everywhere: 1.0 USD on Yahoo, 0.4 USD on ESPN and 1 USD in our auction last season. His Yahoo rank of 136 puts him at the edge of the 144 drafted players. No category is flagged as a punt fit for him, and his FT% (z -1.4) and weak defensive stats make him a scorer with little 9-cat support. Take him only as a last-dollar flyer. In the first weeks, check whether he keeps starting, gets more than about 21 minutes and is on the floor to close games. Drop him quickly if not, and note the two-game semifinal week if you plan to hold him.
